conditions.IdentityConflict: The site identity conflicts with another site.
conditions.NamespaceConflict: The site namespace identity conflicts with this site.
conditions.AwaitingBinding: Waiting for Gitea to bind the runtime identity.
conditions.CleanupAuthorizationRequired: Waiting for Gitea to authorize runtime data cleanup.
conditions.AwaitingExecutionLease: Waiting for the active Manager execution lease.
conditions.PodTerminating: Waiting for the previous runtime process to stop.
conditions.WriterConflict: Another Pod may still be writing to the workspace volume.
conditions.WriterUnconfirmed: Waiting for confirmation that the previous writer stopped.
conditions.DeploymentPending: The component workload is not ready.

environment.title: Environment templates
environment.isolationHelp: Select the isolation technology available on the cluster.
environment.runtimeClassHelp: The selected RuntimeClass starts every Codespace Pod created from this template.
environment.storageClassHelp: The selected StorageClass provisions the persistent workspace volume.
environment.volumeAccessHelp: ReadWriteOncePod provides exclusive Pod access. Use ReadWriteOnce only with a verified storage and recovery setup.
environment.computeHelp: Requests reserve capacity; limits cap the resources available to each Codespace.
environment.webIDEEnabled: Install and start the platform Web IDE
environment.webIDEHelp: Options are passed to the code-server Feature. Codespace manages its internal address, port, authentication, workspace, and update policy.
environment.noRuntimeClasses: No labeled RuntimeClass is available. Add the isolation label to a RuntimeClass before creating a template.
environment.noStorageClasses: No StorageClass is available in the cluster.
environment.invalidRuntimeClass: Select a RuntimeClass that matches the isolation mode.
environment.invalidStorageSize: Enter a positive workspace storage size.
environment.invalidResources: The CPU and memory resource configuration is incomplete.
environment.invalidResourceRange: The {resource} request must be positive and no greater than its limit.
environment.invalidWebIDEOptions: code-server Feature options must be a JSON object.
environment.invalidFeatures: Additional Features must be a JSON object whose values are option objects.
environment.deleteContent: Templates selected by a site must be removed from that site first.

site.title: Gitea sites
site.caBundleHelp: Add PEM-encoded CA certificates when this HTTPS site uses an internal certificate authority. Leave empty to use the system trust store.
site.caBundleHTTPS: Custom CA certificates apply to HTTPS sites.
site.registrationTokenHelp: Copy the reusable token from the Codespace Managers page in Gitea. It is exchanged for this site's own runtime identity and is not stored.
site.assignmentsHelp: Select the environment templates and managed components available to this Gitea site.
site.lifecycleHelp: Enabling the site starts synchronization. New Codespaces can be paused independently while existing operations finish.
site.quotaHelp: When enabled, Kubernetes enforces the combined requests and storage used by this site's Codespaces.
site.upstreamsHelp: Allow the CIDRs and TCP ports used by Gitea HTTP or SSH cloning and by required lifecycle commands.
site.deleteContent: The site namespace is removed after its resources have been cleaned up.

component.title: Components
component.computeHelp: Requests reserve capacity for the component; limits cap its Pod resources.
component.gatewayReplicasHelp: Run multiple interchangeable Gateway Pods so traffic remains available during a Pod failure or rolling update.
component.invalidReplicas: Gateway replicas must be a whole number between 1 and 64.
component.publicExposureHelp: The component Service always provides HTTP on port 80 and SSH on port 22. Manager can publish HTTP with an Ingress and SSH with a dedicated LoadBalancer, or leave either path to the cluster operator.
component.trustedProxiesHelp: Only immediate peers in these networks may provide X-Forwarded-For. Leave empty when traffic reaches the Service directly.
component.maxCacheSizeHelp: Cache cleanup keeps stored data at or below this size.
component.volumeSizeHelp: Persistent volume capacity for cache data and reserved free space.
component.storageClassHelp: Select the StorageClass used to provision the cache volume.
component.mirrorHelp: Each registry host is mirrored only for the listed repository prefixes. A trailing * allows repositories below that prefix.
component.deleteCacheContent: Remove site references, disable the cache, and wait for its writer lease to expire before deleting it.
component.deleteGatewayContent: Sites must stop referencing this component before it can be deleted.
component.rotateTitle: Rotate the SSH host key for {name}?
component.rotateContent: SSH access is temporarily unavailable while the Gateway publishes its new host key.
component.duplicateRegistry: Registry hosts must be present and unique.
component.emptyMirrorRepositories: Each registry mirror must allow at least one repository prefix.
component.invalidResources: The CPU and memory requests and limits must all be configured.
component.invalidResourceRange: The {resource} request must be positive and no greater than its limit.
component.invalidIngressPort: A managed Ingress uses the standard HTTP or HTTPS port; remove the explicit port from the endpoint URL.
component.invalidCacheSizes: The cache size and reserved free space must be positive and fit within the volume.
component.invalidDuration: Cache retention and cleanup intervals must be positive.

proxy.runtimeHelp: These settings are passed to the runtime and Dev Containers for Git over HTTP(S), Docker image pulls and builds, Feature retrieval, and applications that honor standard proxy environment variables.
proxy.cacheHelp: The Cache service uses these settings to reach upstream image registries and S3 storage. Cluster-internal addresses are added to the bypass list automatically.
proxy.urlHelp: Use a complete URL with an explicit port. Include authentication in the standard URL user-information section and URL-encode reserved characters.
proxy.socksHelp: Sets ALL_PROXY and is also used when the HTTP or HTTPS proxy is empty.
proxy.noProxyHelp: Enter one host, domain suffix, IP address, or CIDR per line. Cluster-local destinations are added automatically.
proxy.caBundleHelp: PEM certificates trusted in addition to the system roots.

runtime.title: Running environments
runtime.deleteContent: Disable the owning site first. This permanently removes the environment and its stored data after the previous runtime has stopped.
runtime.recoveryContent: Confirm only after the previous runtime Pod can no longer write to its volume. The runtime will converge to stopped before it can be resumed.

errors.session_expired: The administration session expired. Sign in again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again shortly.
errors.resource_conflict: The resource changed. Reload before saving.
errors.resource_in_use: The resource is still in use.
